context: Choose the single Pixel evidence route that best serves the question. Use mixed_or_other only when two or more evidence kinds are explicitly required, no single kind dominates, or none of the eight kinds applies.

criteria.lookup: Find a specific identifier, declaration, value, or location.
criteria.impact: Find callers, dependents, affected code, or blast radius.
criteria.flow: Trace an ordered execution or data path across components.
criteria.diagnosis: Explain a failure, guard, fallback, or observed behavior.
criteria.configuration: Find settings, config sources, install destinations, or precedence.
criteria.tests: Find tests, assertions, validation commands, or coverage.
criteria.history: Find recorded prior decisions, changes, issue notes, or provenance; do not infer undocumented rationale.
criteria.architecture: Map component boundaries, responsibilities, or dependencies.
criteria.mixed_or_other: The request explicitly needs at least two distinct evidence kinds, has no dominant kind, or falls outside these kinds.
